result.keyword: Who are the top medical negligence lawyers in Perth?
result.markdown:
When looking for top medical negligence lawyers in Perth, choices generally depend on whether you are seeking representation as a **plaintiff** (an individual pursuing a claim against a hospital, doctor, or health provider) or as a **defendant** (hospitals, medical practitioners, or insurers).

According to independent legal directory rankings (such as *Doyle's Guide*) and industry standing, the leading firms and practitioners in Perth are categorized below:[jjlaw.com.au](https://jjlaw.com.au/about-us/#:~:text=Recognition%20%26%20Awards.%20Our%20expertise%20in%20medical,Bavin.%20Director.%20L.%20*%20Anna%20Sundararajan.%20Director.)

### Plaintiff-Focused Lawyers & Firms (Representing Patients)

If you are looking to file a claim for medical negligence, misdiagnosis, or surgical errors, these firms and lawyers are recognized leaders in Western Australia:

* **Julian Johnson Lawyers**
  *   * **Overview:** Consistently ranked by Doyle's Guide as a leading Medical Negligence Compensation Law Firm in Western Australia.[jjlaw.com.au](https://jjlaw.com.au/about-us/#:~:text=Our%20expertise%20in%20medical%20negligence%20has%20been,Negligence%20Compensation%20Law%20Firm%20in%20Western%20Australia.)
  * **Key Lawyers:** Kimberley Bavin (Director), Anna Sundararajan (Director), Tanya Watson (Special Counsel), and Susan Hillman (Senior Associate).[jjlaw.com.au](https://jjlaw.com.au/about-us/#:~:text=Medical%20Injury%20%26%20Compensation%20Lawyer%20%7C%20Julian,Recognition%20%26%20Awards%20*%20Kimberley%20Bavin.%20Director.)
* **Brand Barristers & Solicitors**
  *   * **Overview:** Highly regarded boutique firm specializing in complex litigation, with leading practitioner recognition for plaintiff medical negligence.[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-western-australia-2026/#:~:text=Leading%20Medical%20Negligence%20Compensation%20Lawyers%20%28Plaintiff%29%20%E2%80%93,Julian%20Johnson%20Lawyers.%20Marie%20Eberlein%2C%20Maurice%20Blackburn.)
  * **Key Lawyers:** Daniel Brand and Ben Hansberry.
* **Maurice Blackburn Lawyers**
  *   * **Overview:** One of Australia's largest national plaintiff law firms, with a dedicated Perth medical negligence and injury team.[www.mauriceblackburn.com.au](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/medical-injury/medical-negligence-lawyers-perth/#:~:text=Our%20team%20of%20dedicated%20medical%20negligence%20lawyers,medNegQuestions.%20*%20injuryImpact.%20*%20medNegDateRange.%20*%20medNegDateRange2.) They generally operate on a "No Win, No Fee" basis.[www.mauriceblackburn.com.au](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/medical-injury/medical-negligence-lawyers-perth/#:~:text=Our%20lawyers%20will%20work%20with%20you%20through,Fee'%20basis%20and%20offer%20free%20initial%20consultations.)
  * **Key Lawyers:** Marie Eberlein (Senior Associate & State Leader for Medical Negligence).
* **Other Recommended Firms & Practitioners:**
  *   * **Slater & Gordon Lawyers** (including Sarah Marshman)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-western-australia-2026/#:~:text=Susan%20Hillman%2C%20Julian%20Johnson%20Lawyers.%20Sarah%20Marshman%2C,nominations%20and%20interviews%20and%20cannot%20be%20purchased.)
  * **Foyle Legal** (including Jeffrey Potter)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-western-australia-2026/#:~:text=Susan%20Hillman%2C%20Julian%20Johnson%20Lawyers.%20Sarah%20Marshman%2C,nominations%20and%20interviews%20and%20cannot%20be%20purchased.)

  * **Bradford Legal[www.bradfordlegal.com.au](https://www.bradfordlegal.com.au/)**

### Defendant-Focused Firms (Hospitals, Insurers & Health Providers)

If you are a medical professional, clinic, or insurer looking for defense representation in malpractice or coronial inquiries:

* **Panetta McGrath Lawyers**
  *   * **Overview:** Widely recognized as a top-tier specialist firm in Western Australia for health law, medical defense, and professional malpractice litigation.
  * **Key Lawyers:** Enore Panetta and Gemma McGrath.[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-malpractice-lawyers-western-australia-2025/#:~:text=Preeminent.%20Gemma%20McGrath%2C%20Panetta%20McGrath.%20Enore%20Panetta%2C,and%20are%20not%20ranked%20against%20each%20other.)

---

### Tips for Choosing the Right Lawyer:

1.  **Plaintiff Specialization:** Ensure the lawyer specifically handles **medical negligence (malpractice)** rather than just general motor vehicle or workers' compensation claims, as medical litigation requires navigating complex hospital records, expert medical witness testimonies, and strict liability laws.
2.  **Fee Structures:** Most plaintiff firms offer **"No Win, No Fee"** arrangements (though you should always check whether out-of-pocket disbursements like expert witness reports are covered).
3.  **Initial Consultation:** Take advantage of free initial consultations to discuss the viability and potential merits of your case before committing.[www.mauriceblackburn.com.au](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/medical-injury/medical-negligence-lawyers-perth/#:~:text=Contact%20us%20*%20Free%20initial%20consultation.%20We,conveniently%20located%20in%20Perth%20and%20across%20Australia.)
